// note: 'shapeOnly' is the only comparison mode, and every alias declares it: it says two subtrees are equivalent in purpose but structurally incomparable, so one ShapeDiffers row is emitted at the alias root and the noise beneath it is suppressed.

aliases.note: Two tiers hold a 6-key Redis object (ConnectionString, Password, Enabled, Database, ConnectTimeoutMs, SyncTimeoutMs); the others hold a single RedisCache:Configuration packed StackExchange connection string. This is a shape conversion, not a rename - do not treat it as one. Every configured tier needs an entry here: the side-by-side view drops an alias for ALL tiers if one is missing.

Later tiers split their Couchbase scopes per concern where earlier ones fold several into a single scope. Without this the diff shows ~8 phantom add/removes. A wildcard alias needs the pattern character-identical in every tier or it disengages entirely.
